title: Exclude single cocharted BIT helper relations with complete causal-bank and target accounting
body:
A single cocharted binary helper relation cannot improve the complete signed moment of the fixed PR7001 BIT word for `0<=kappa<=1/100`, in either orientation. This exclusion grants free storage of every past receiver bank and free scalar XOR work, but charges the lost productive helper. **No new kappa is claimed.**

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/PROOF.md), [summary receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/RESULT.json), [full certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/CERTIFICATE.json.gz), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/verify.py), [input pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/SOURCES.json) and [credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/CREDITS.md). The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19713992) records the changed helper contract and overlap check.

The source has 659 public fields, 437 helpers in nine boundary groups, 237 owned labels and 2871 paid moves. At each chart, all entrance and retained paid rows are independent. A single helper relation can therefore remove at most one paid bank at that chart: the last token in its unique receiver witness. The exact receiver-space certificate reduces all possible relations to the following finite cases and terminal bounds.

| Orientation | Exceptional directions | Maximum nonterminal clean dimension |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Forward | 664 | 4 |
| Transpose | 125 | 2 |

Every exceptional direction saves strictly less integer paid rank than the productive rank it loses. The exact inequality `d^99>(d-1)^100` converts that deficit into a strict signed-moment loss throughout the stated interval. Every other direction can remove only one terminal bank of rank at most the lost target. The largest group has `2^410-1` nonzero relations; a complete terminal prefix-rank certificate covers the unlisted directions.

Both implementations recount the complete 36-call invoice: 107352 paid calls, 19950 productive targets and rank surplus 1506. Fixed query, idle and root terms cancel; the native difference is multiplied by 36. No paid-count-only or frozen-caller ceiling claim is used. This result blocks a specific proposed improvement route; it does not improve the selected saving `.00363005817` or change the source BIT admission.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Inputs are the exact [native](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d777f3a0aa2878bea0478918923dabcf86b9878b/research/paired-query-only-bit/retained/inputs/BIT-NATIVE-WORD.json.gz) and [caller](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d777f3a0aa2878bea0478918923dabcf86b9878b/research/paired-query-only-bit/EFREE-CALLER.json.gz) from [PR #7001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7001), head `d777f3a0aa2878bea0478918923dabcf86b9878b`. The native SHA-256 is `51203e7fc75ba10bd3ac3f8e675759f47e13d262bea66b6600d1e515095cad78`.

This differs from the productive splits in [PR #7304](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7304) and [PR #7573](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7573): it surrenders one old productive helper. The older helper deletion and fixed-anchor exclusion in [PR #1043](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1043) and [PR #1250](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1250) use another word. The helper splits in [PR #5679](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5679) and [PR #5708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5708) and rational quotients in [PR #7713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7713) supply related methods, not this binary certificate. The premise lift in [PR #7618](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7618) is separate.

Use CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_SINGLE_BIT_RELATION_OBSTRUCTION 18 group-orientations; 789 exceptional directions; 6 rejected mutations; exact frame and full invoice checks
```

Normal and optimized replay pass. Packed-row/highest-pivot construction agrees with a set-based/lowest-pivot replay on every paid row and all public endpoints. The second checker proves each receiver dimension by projection rank and checks terminal coverage by prefix ranks. All 636 rational frames and 2374 strict nested paid pairs pass. Six mutations are rejected: missing debit, receiver, noncoordinate direction, witness token, causal order and terminal pivot. Exact input/notice bytes, committed bytes/modes, source history, export, sealed read-only Git-free replay, public links and rendered publication readback pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44363120049/job/135009574126) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The exclusion keeps paid forms and their order fixed. Multiple relations, new routes, changed capture forms, mixed boundary groups, matrix-valued receiver coefficients and compositions across orientations are outside scope. The physical caller identity, native phases, owned storage, compiler, tape and analytic interfaces remain inherited, with all five framework assumptions. Full predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. This is author checking after reading the source, not blind, independent human or formal acceptance. No selected-frontier change or edit to another workstream is included.
